description: Extension methods for registering Tempo.Blazor services.

members.name: AddInMemoryNotifications
members.description: Replaces the default with so notifications are kept in memory. Also replaces with the same store so the badge count is live. Use this in demo / test applications where you want to see notifications without a real backend.

members.name: AddTempoBlazor
members.description: Registers all required Tempo.Blazor services. : Singleton (stateless, thread-safe, backed by .resx) : Scoped (per-circuit in Server mode, per-tab in WASM) : Scoped (per-circuit in Server mode, per-tab in WASM) : Singleton, pre-loaded with Add this call to your Blazor Program.cs: builder.Services.AddTempoBlazor(); To add custom wireframe components, call after AddTempoBlazor(): builder.Services.AddTempoBlazor(); builder.Services.AddWireframeComponentProvider<MyCustomProvider>(); To override the built-in localization with your own strings, register a custom ITmLocalizer AFTER this call: builder.Services.AddTempoBlazor(); builder.Services.AddSingleton<ITmLocalizer, MyCustomTmLocalizer>(); To support Czech localization, configure culture in Program.cs: var culture = new System.Globalization.CultureInfo("cs"); System.Globalization.CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentCulture = culture; System.Globalization.CultureInfo.DefaultThreadCurrentUICulture = culture;
